description: Dehalo pre-clean pass: two chained Topaz Video AI models run at 1:1 (no resolution change) between denoise and upscale, to remove ringing/halo artifacts from oversharpened DVD sources. The model shortnames and parameters here are NOT guessed from the GUI's slider labels -- they were reverse-engineered by capturing the real ffmpeg.exe command line Topaz Video AI itself ran for this exact GUI stack (1st enhancement = Iris, Input condition = Medium quality, Advanced tuning = Automatic, Recover detail = 100; 2nd enhancement = Artemis, Input condition = Strong Halo, Recover detail = 100).
_note_recover_detail: Despite 'Recover detail = 100' being set in the GUI for both passes, the captured command line shows details=0 for pass 1 -- Advanced tuning = Automatic instead enables estimate=8 (auto frame-sampled parameter analysis), which is what actually drives detail recovery, not the manual 'details' AVOption. Pass 2 (alqs-2) exposes no detail/noise AVOptions in the captured command at all. This preset intentionally matches the real command line, not a literal reading of the GUI sliders.
_note_resize_flags: Matches the captured command line exactly. Harmless here since the final resize target equals the source's own dimensions (no scale change) -- lanczos-vs-bicubic only matters when actually resampling to different dimensions.

encoder._note: Matches deinterlace.py's mezzanine encode settings (cq=14) rather than a final-delivery preset's cq -- this stage's output feeds into upscale.py next, not the end user.
